textos.Lançado em 2022 e dirigido por Mark Gust: Released in 2022 and directed by Mark Gustafson, Guillermo del Toro's Pinocchio is a 117-minute feature film that falls within the genres of animation, fantasy, adventure and drama. The work presents a darker version of the classic children's fairy tale, following the journey in which a wooden puppet becomes a real, living boy.
textos.A experiência é construída por meio da t: The experience is built through the visual technique of stop-motion animation, creating a dense, dark setting with musical passages woven into the plot. The narrative structure adopts a measured pace to join elements of fantasy with a historical and dramatic context.
textos.Os registros mostram que os diferentes g: The records show that the different groups focus their attention on the same fundamental themes, agreeing on what the film is and disagreeing on the final verdict about how well those choices work.
textos.Na grande maioria das notas (~85%), cerc: In the vast majority of ratings (~85%), about half extol the stop-motion animation and the visual design as meticulous, impressive achievements. In addition, a significant share celebrate the story and the adaptation of the classic tale for its mature approach, while many stress the deep emotional weight and impact generated by the narrative.
textos.Na perspectiva de quem se situa numa fra: From the perspective of those who fall within a minimal fraction of the ratings (~12%), most acknowledge the technical quality of the stop-motion animation, but a good portion raise reservations about the musical numbers and several criticize the behavior of the child protagonist.
textos.Já sob o ponto de vista registrado numa: From the viewpoint recorded in an even smaller fraction of the ratings (~3%), a considerable number resent a slow, dragging pace throughout the screening, while some define Pinocchio as an irritating, unpleasant character, and a portion disapprove of the songs, considering them bad and poorly executed.
